subproblem.title: Area formula for an injective Lipschitz C¹ map on a rectifiable set with the tangential Jacobian
subproblem.statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, M ⊆ U Borel and countably n-rectifiable with H^n(M ∩ C) < ∞ for every compact C ⊆ U, and φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P a C¹, Lipschitz, injective map. For x ∈ ℝ^P let Q(x) := approxTangentPlane n M x, e = (e_a) the standard orthonormal basis of Q(x) (stdOrthonormalBasis) and J(x) := (det(Dφ(x)e_a · Dφ(x)e_b)_{a,b})^{1/2}. Then for every g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] (no measurability required), ∫⁻_{φ(M)} g dH^n = ∫⁻_M J(x) g(φ(x)) dH^n(x).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → M ⊆ U → CountablyRectifiable n M → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M ∩ C) ≠ ∞) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → LipschitzWith Λ φ → Injective φ → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in φ '' M, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x)) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x) i)) (fderiv ℝ φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x) j))))) * g (φ x) ∂μHE[n]
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 7 of the parent proof; Simon Ch. 3, 2.3–2.6 (chapter-03.txt lines 362–411: J^M_f = sqrt(det(D_{τ_p}f · D_{τ_q}f)) for an orthonormal basis τ of T_xM, and for 1:1 f, ∫_M h J^M_f dH^n = ∫_{f(M)} h∘f^{-1} dH^n, formula 2.6), proved through the bi-Lipschitz pieces instead of Simon's C¹ pieces; details filled in. Notation: E := ℝ^P, H^n := μHE[n], λ := Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n, Q(x) := approxTangentPlane n M x; for a linear L : E → E and a subspace V with standard orthonormal basis e^V (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ V), J(L, V) := sqrt(det(⟨L e^V_a, L e^V_b⟩)_{a,b}); so J(x) = J(Dφ(x), Q(x)). Let Λ be a Lipschitz constant of φ. Provenance: this statement and its frozen Lean type are byte-identical to Submission.dpf_area_formula_bilipschitz_rectifiable (node root.minimizing_implies_stationary-a1.diffeo_pushforward-a1.rectifiable_area_formula-a1, not yet accepted, owned by another parent); the proof below is that node's parent-supplied proof with the sibling density lemma renamed to codim1_ldr_dpf_approxTangent_ae_bilipschitz_piece, and it does not use that node.
1. Pieces. By the sibling dpf_rectifiable_bilipschitz_pieces: Lipschitz F_i (constants L_i), Borel B_i, m_i > 0, the lower bound on B_i (so F_i is injective on B_i), differentiability with injective derivative on B_i, P_i := F_i(B_i) Borel ⊆ M pairwise disjoint, Z := M ∖ ⋃ P_i with H^n(Z) = 0.
2. Tangent identification. By the sibling codim1_ldr_dpf_approxTangent_ae_bilipschitz_piece with Y := M (Borel, ⊆ U, locally H^n-finite) and (F_i, B_i, L_i, m_i): for λ-a.e. b ∈ B_i, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M (F_i b) (range DF_i(b)); by the definition of approxTangentPlane (Exists.choose_spec) and uniqueness of approximate tangent planes (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique), Q(F_i b) = range DF_i(b) for λ-a.e. b ∈ B_i.
3. Jacobian identity. For L and V as in the notation, normDet(L|_V)² = det(⟨L e^V_a, L e^V_b⟩) (Mathlib LinearMap.normDet_sq_eq_det_gram with the orthonormal basis e^V of V, applied to L|_V = (L : E →ₗ E).domRestrict V, whose values on e^V_a are L e^V_a) and normDet ≥ 0, hence normDet(L|_V) = J(L, V). In particular J(x) = normDet(Dφ(x)|_{Q(x)}).
4. Splitting both sides. φ is injective, so φ(M) = φ(Z) ∪ ⋃_i φ(P_i) with all these sets pairwise disjoint; each φ(P_i) is Borel (Lusin–Souslin: φ continuous and injective) and H^n(φ(Z)) ≤ Λ^n H^n(Z) = 0. For any h : E → [0, ∞] and S = S₀ ∪ ⋃_i S_i with H^n(S₀) = 0 and S_i measurable and pairwise disjoint, H^n⌞S = H^n⌞(⋃ S_i) (the sets are a.e. equal; Measure.restrict_congr_set), and ∫⁻_{⋃S_i} h dH^n = Σ_i ∫⁻_{S_i} h dH^n (Mathlib lintegral_iUnion: measurable disjoint pieces, no measurability of h needed). Therefore ∫⁻_{φ(M)} g dH^n = Σ_i ∫⁻_{φ(P_i)} g dH^n and ∫⁻_M J(x) g(φx) dH^n(x) = Σ_i ∫⁻_{P_i} J(x) g(φx) dH^n(x). It remains to compare the i-th terms.
5. One piece. Φ_i := φ∘F_i is Lipschitz and injective on B_i, and φ(P_i) = Φ_i(B_i) (Set.image_comp); the area formula below is stated with μHE[finrank ℝ ℝ^n], which is μHE[n] by finrank_euclideanSpace_fin. For b ∈ B_i, DΦ_i(b) = Dφ(F_i b)∘DF_i(b) (chain rule; φ is C¹) and normDet(DΦ_i(b)) = normDet(Dφ(F_i b)|_{range DF_i(b)}) · normDet(DF_i(b)) (Mathlib LinearMap.normDet_comp). By the weighted injective Lipschitz area formula (SimonGMT weighted_area_formula_lipschitz_injOn; finrank ℝ ℝ^n = n; it accepts an arbitrary weight E → [0, ∞] and gives ∫⁻_{f(s)} w dH^n = ∫⁻_s ofReal(areaJacobianAt f a) w(f a) dλ, with areaJacobianAt f a = normDet(Df(a))):
 ∫⁻_{φ(P_i)} g dH^n = ∫⁻_{B_i} normDet(DΦ_i(b)) g(Φ_i b) db = ∫⁻_{B_i} normDet(DF_i(b)) · [normDet(Dφ(F_i b)|_{range DF_i(b)}) g(φ(F_i b))] db (ofReal of a product of nonnegative reals is the product of the ofReals).
 By steps 2 and 3, for λ-a.e. b ∈ B_i, normDet(Dφ(F_i b)|_{range DF_i(b)}) = normDet(Dφ(F_i b)|_{Q(F_i b)}) = J(F_i b), so by lintegral_congr_ae the last integral equals ∫⁻_{B_i} normDet(DF_i(b)) w(F_i b) db with w(x) := J(x) g(φ(x)), which by the same area formula for F_i (Lipschitz, injective on B_i) equals ∫⁻_{F_i(B_i)} w dH^n = ∫⁻_{P_i} J(x) g(φ(x)) dH^n(x).
6. Summing step 5 over i and using step 4 gives ∫⁻_{φ(M)} g dH^n = ∫⁻_M J(x) g(φ(x)) dH^n(x). (Uniform in n ≥ 0: for n = 0, Q(x) = {0} a.e., the Gram matrix is empty and J = 1, and normDet of maps out of ℝ^0 is 1. Imports: the Lean proof needs Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.AreaLipschitz and Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.NormDet, which the submission may import.)
proof_key_steps: Decompose M into disjoint bi-Lipschitz pieces P_i = F_i(B_i) plus a null set; φ(M) decomposes likewise.
Q(F_i b) = range DF_i(b) for a.e. b ∈ B_i by the density lemma and uniqueness of tangent planes.
normDet(L|_V) equals the Gram-determinant expression in any orthonormal basis of V.
On each piece, the weighted area formula for φ∘F_i, normDet_comp, the a.e. tangent identification and the area formula for F_i give ∫⁻_{φ(P_i)} g = ∫⁻_{P_i} J·(g∘φ).
Sum over the pieces using lintegral_iUnion (no measurability of g needed).

audit.reason: The piecewise area formulas, normDet composition identity and almost-everywhere tangent identification establish the exact Gram-Jacobian formula. Both cited integration results permit arbitrary weights, so no missing measurability hypothesis is needed.
